title: The Starless Sea
author: Erin Morgenstern
summary: A graduate student finds a strange book in his university library that contains a scene from his own childhood. His search for its origin leads him to a hidden society and an underground library of stories by a sea of honey.
readIf: you love books about books, interlocking tales and dreamlike settings that you can wander through.
skipIf: you want a straightforward plot, as it jumps between narratives and is slow to fit together.

pairings.reason: Same author, a more focused and more romantic fantasy with a similar love of enchanted places.
Another strange, hushed fantasy about a vast, mysterious building and a person finding their place in it.
Another story driven by a mysterious book and a secret library, set in a more gothic, historical world.
